name: gotlike-conformance
description: Runs got's and nock's own test suites against gotlike and its nock shim
author: Ivan Kotlaja

scripts.got: npm --prefix .. run build && node run.ts got
scripts.nock: npm --prefix .. run build && node run.ts nock
scripts.all: npm --prefix .. run build && node run.ts got && node run.ts nock
scripts.update: npm --prefix .. run build && node run.ts got --update && node run.ts nock --update
